_comment: Copy to canvas-text.rules.json and edit. `banned` runs over src/data/*.ts;
`bundleSafe` is the subset re-run over dist-offline/index.html, where
minified identifiers and font bytes collide with word-level rules, so it
holds only identifier and phrase greps that cannot collide.
Rules are "/pattern/flags" or a bare pattern (defaults to gi).
`values.toConfirmMap` ties an open value in a YAML source of truth to the exact
node ids that must carry status: 'to-confirm'. Keep that map EXPLICIT.
`values` is OPTIONAL and is left OUT by default — a configured path that does not
exist is a finding, not a crash. To enable it, rename "_valuesExample" to "values",
point `file` at your YAML source of truth and list the node ids per open key.
`vocabularyFile` is optional: without it the linter auto-detects the one
src/data view that declares a legend, and fails if there are none or many.
